summary.tldr: Creates a Parliamentary Visual Artist Laureate to promote the arts through Parliament and fixes an English-language reference in the Parliament of Canada Act.
what_it_does: Creates the office of Parliamentary Visual Artist Laureate as an officer of the Library of Parliament.
Sets the selection process, the two Speakers choose the laureate from a confidential list of three names, with the holder’s primary official language alternating.
Limits the term to up to two years and lets the Speakers remove the holder at will.

Gives the laureate a mandate to promote the arts through Parliament, including awareness, enjoyment and development of the arts, and to create art, sponsor events and advise on the Library’s collection.
Corrects the English version of the Parliament of Canada Act so the selection rule for the Parliamentary Poet Laureate refers properly to the Canada Council for the Arts.
who_it_affects: Speakers of the Senate and House of Commons
summary.background: The bill adds a new section to the Parliament of Canada Act. It also amends the English version of the Act’s rule for choosing the Parliamentary Poet Laureate.
